source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original mapping patch accepts both message and x-moz channel schemes for EWS and Graph, while still running the path/ref transformation. Its four assertions check schemes only. Fixed accepted GetUrlForUri instead forwards an existing x-moz URI as-is before the message-URI rewrite. Scheme coverage does not establish full path/query/ref identity or actual message loading.
title: Exchange URL scheme mapping and whole-URI identity are separate contracts
